introduction: The `afhub` package is an async Python HTTP client for the af-hub carry-patch REST API, providing Pydantic data models, a typed error hierarchy, auth helpers, and polling utilities. Note: requirements referencing httpx and pydantic APIs are based on PRD assumptions and should be cross-checked against the installed library versions before implementation.

glossary.AF_HUB_TOKEN: Environment variable that holds the hub Personal Access Token, used by resolve_hub_pat as a fallback when no token flag is provided
glossary.AF_HUB_URL: Environment variable that holds the hub base URL, used by resolve_hub_url as a fallback when no URL flag is provided
glossary.ConnectError: httpx exception raised when a TCP connection cannot be established (e.g. DNS failure, refused connection)
glossary.ConnectTimeout: httpx exception raised when a TCP connection attempt exceeds the configured timeout
glossary.HubAuthError: Exception raised when the hub returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized
glossary.HubClient: The primary async HTTP client class in the afhub package that wraps httpx.AsyncClient and exposes all hub API operations
glossary.HubConflictError: Exception raised when the hub returns HTTP 409 Conflict; stores error_type for caller inspection
glossary.HubConnectionError: Exception raised when a network-level failure persists after all retries are exhausted
glossary.HubError: Base exception class for all hub API errors; carries status_code, message, and error_type
glossary.HubForbiddenError: Exception raised when the hub returns HTTP 403 Forbidden
glossary.HubModeError: Exception raised when the hub returns a 400 response with error_type 'workspace_mode_mismatch'
glossary.HubNoActivePatchesError: Exception raised when the hub returns a 400 response with error_type 'no_active_patches'
glossary.HubNotFoundError: Exception raised when the hub returns HTTP 404 Not Found
glossary.PAT: Personal Access Token — a bearer credential used to authenticate requests to the af-hub REST API
glossary.Patch: Pydantic model representing a carry-patch entry within a workspace
glossary.PatchDetail: Pydantic model representing the status of a single patch within a PatchStatusDashboard; fields: id (str), branch_name (str), position (int), status (str), last_rebuild_result (str|None), conflict_files (list[str]|None), description (str|None, default None)
glossary.PatchResult: Pydantic model representing the outcome of applying a single patch during a rebuild
glossary.PatchStatusDashboard: Pydantic model representing the full patch status view for a workspace, including per-patch details and a summary
glossary.PatchSummary: Pydantic model representing aggregate counts of patches by status within a PatchStatusDashboard
glossary.ReadTimeout: httpx exception raised when reading a response body exceeds the configured timeout
glossary.RebuildJob: Pydantic model representing an asynchronous rebuild job on the hub
glossary.RebuildPreview: Pydantic model representing a dry-run preview of what a rebuild would produce
glossary.RebuildPreviewPatchResult: Pydantic model representing the predicted outcome for a single patch in a RebuildPreview
glossary.RerereEntry: Pydantic model representing a recorded rerere conflict resolution
glossary.SyncResult: Pydantic model representing the result of a workspace sync operation
glossary.Workspace: Pydantic model representing a hub workspace resource, including clone and sync status fields
glossary.aclose: Async method on HubClient that closes the underlying httpx.AsyncClient and releases connection pool resources
glossary.add_patch: HubClient method that creates a single patch by sending a single-object JSON body to POST /patches
glossary.add_patches_batch: HubClient method that creates multiple patches by sending a JSON array body to POST /patches
glossary.asyncio_mode: pytest-asyncio configuration option; when set to 'auto', all async test functions are automatically treated as asyncio coroutines
glossary.clone_failed: Synthetic error_type used by poll_clone_ready when the workspace clone_status transitions to 'failed'
glossary.clone_status: A field on the Workspace model indicating the current state of the workspace git clone (e.g. 'ready', 'failed', 'pending')
glossary.error_type: A string discriminator field in the hub error envelope that identifies the specific error category (e.g. 'workspace_mode_mismatch', 'no_active_patches')
glossary.extra_ignore: Pydantic model configuration (extra='ignore') that silently discards unknown fields in API responses, enabling forward compatibility
glossary.forget_rerere: HubClient method that calls DELETE /workspaces/:slug/rerere/*pathspec and returns None on 204
glossary.get_patch_status: HubClient method that calls GET /workspaces/:slug/patch-status and returns a PatchStatusDashboard
glossary.get_resolved_variables: HubClient method that calls GET /vars/resolved and returns a dict mapping variable keys to their resolved string values
glossary.list_rebuilds: HubClient method that calls GET /rebuilds and unwraps the 'jobs' array from the response envelope
glossary.list_rerere: HubClient method that calls GET /rerere and unwraps the 'resolutions' array from the response envelope
glossary.no_active_patches: error_type value returned by the hub when an operation requires active patches but none exist
glossary.poll_clone_ready: Async polling helper that repeatedly calls get_workspace() until clone_status is 'ready' or 'failed', or timeout elapses
glossary.poll_rebuild: Async polling helper that repeatedly calls get_rebuild() until the RebuildJob reaches a terminal status or timeout elapses
glossary.reclone_workspace: HubClient method that calls POST /workspaces/:slug/reclone and returns the updated Workspace
glossary.remove_patch: HubClient method that calls DELETE /patches/:id and returns None on 204
glossary.reorder_patches: HubClient method that calls POST /patches/reorder with an ordered list of patch IDs
glossary.resolve_hub_pat: Auth helper function that resolves the hub PAT from a CLI flag, then environment variable, then returns None
glossary.resolve_hub_url: Auth helper function that resolves the hub base URL from a CLI flag, then environment variable, then a pre-resolved config string, then returns None
glossary.rollback_rebuild: HubClient method that calls POST /rebuilds/:id/rollback and extracts the previous_integration_head_sha string from the response
glossary.set_variable: HubClient convenience upsert method that tries PATCH /vars/:key first and falls back to POST /vars on 404
glossary.slug: A URL-safe string identifier for a hub workspace (e.g. 'my-workspace')
glossary.submit_rebuild: HubClient method that calls POST /rebuild and returns a RebuildJob from the 202 response
glossary.sync_workspace: HubClient method that calls POST /workspaces/:slug/sync and returns a SyncResult
glossary.workspace_mode_mismatch: error_type value returned by the hub when an operation is incompatible with the workspace's current mode

user_story.goal: wait for a rebuild job or workspace clone to reach a terminal state without implementing a polling loop manually

acceptance_criteria.action: call client.get_rebuild(slug, rebuild_id) immediately on entry (without a preceding sleep); after each non-terminal result, sleep interval seconds via asyncio.sleep before the next poll; repeat until the RebuildJob status is one of 'completed', 'failed', 'dead_letter', or 'cancelled'

requirements.title: Transient error retry with exponential backoff

user_story.goal: have transient network errors retried automatically without writing retry logic
user_story.benefit: my code is resilient to brief network interruptions without additional complexity

acceptance_criteria.action: retry the request up to 3 times with exponential backoff: wait base 1 s * (factor 2 ^ attempt), capped at 30 s per interval, using asyncio.sleep between retries
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the request succeeds if a retry succeeds; raises HubConnectionError after 3 failed retries
acceptance_criteria.trigger: httpx raises ConnectTimeout, ReadTimeout, or ConnectError during a request

acceptance_criteria.action: only retry on ConnectTimeout, ReadTimeout, and ConnectError (the specific named subclasses) — not on other httpx exceptions or HTTP error status codes; httpx.WriteTimeout, httpx.PoolTimeout, and any other httpx exception not in this whitelist propagate immediately without retrying
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: non-retryable errors are raised immediately without any retry delay

edge_cases.action: raise HubConnectionError after the third failure
edge_cases.return_contract: raises HubConnectionError; exactly 3 retry attempts were made (4 total attempts including the original)

user_story.role: developer integrating the afhub package into a monorepo
user_story.goal: have a well-structured package that targets hub API v1 exclusively and declares compatible dependency bounds

acceptance_criteria.action: prefix all endpoint paths with /api/v1/ so that every request targets hub API v1 exclusively
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: every HTTP request URL contains /api/v1/ as the path prefix

acceptance_criteria.action: declare runtime dependencies as httpx>=0.27 and pydantic>=2.0, and dev/test dependencies as pytest and pytest-asyncio, with Python >=3.12
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the package installs successfully in a Python 3.12+ environment alongside afissues and agentfox without dependency conflicts

acceptance_criteria.action: organize source files as: afhub/__init__.py, afhub/client.py, afhub/models.py, afhub/errors.py, afhub/auth.py, afhub/polling.py, afhub/_http.py, and tests/ directory with test_client.py, test_models.py, test_errors.py, test_auth.py, test_polling.py
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the package layout matches the specified structure

acceptance_criteria.action: use pytest with asyncio_mode=auto so all async test functions run as asyncio coroutines without explicit decorators, and use unittest.mock.AsyncMock and MagicMock for httpx mocking with no external mock library
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: pytest --asyncio-mode=auto runs all tests successfully

edge_cases.return_contract: no version negotiation requests are issued; breaking hub API changes require a new client version

edge_cases.return_contract: new fields in hub responses do not cause validation errors

correctness_properties.title: Authorization header on every request
correctness_properties.for_any: HubClient instance with a given PAT
correctness_properties.invariant: every HTTP request issued by the HubClient carries an Authorization: Bearer <pat> header matching the PAT provided at construction time

correctness_properties.title: API v1 path prefix on every request
correctness_properties.invariant: the URL of every outgoing HTTP request contains /api/v1/ as the path prefix

correctness_properties.title: Extra fields are silently discarded by all models
correctness_properties.for_any: any Pydantic model in afhub.models and any dict containing arbitrary extra keys
correctness_properties.invariant: constructing the model from the dict succeeds and the extra keys are not present on the resulting instance

correctness_properties.title: Retry count is bounded at 3
correctness_properties.for_any: any HubClient request that raises ConnectTimeout, ReadTimeout, or ConnectError on every attempt
correctness_properties.invariant: the HTTP layer makes exactly 4 total attempts (1 original + 3 retries) before raising HubConnectionError; it never makes more than 4 attempts

correctness_properties.title: Backoff sleep is capped at 30 seconds
correctness_properties.for_any: any retry sequence of any length
correctness_properties.invariant: asyncio.sleep is never called with a value greater than 30.0 during retry backoff

correctness_properties.title: HubError subclass hierarchy is consistent
correctness_properties.for_any: any instance of HubAuthError, HubForbiddenError, HubNotFoundError, HubConflictError, HubConnectionError, HubModeError, or HubNoActivePatchesError
correctness_properties.invariant: isinstance(instance, HubError) is True for every subclass instance

correctness_properties.title: resolve_hub_pat priority order is stable
correctness_properties.for_any: any combination of token_flag and AF_HUB_TOKEN environment variable values
correctness_properties.invariant: resolve_hub_pat returns token_flag when it is not None, regardless of the AF_HUB_TOKEN value

correctness_properties.title: poll_rebuild terminates on terminal status
correctness_properties.for_any: any sequence of get_rebuild responses where the final response has status in {'completed', 'failed', 'dead_letter', 'cancelled'}
correctness_properties.invariant: poll_rebuild returns the terminal RebuildJob and does not issue any further get_rebuild calls after observing a terminal status

correctness_properties.title: set_variable does not issue a prior GET
correctness_properties.invariant: set_variable issues at most two HTTP requests (PATCH then optionally POST) and never issues a GET /vars/:key request

correctness_properties.title: No-content responses return None
correctness_properties.for_any: any invocation of remove_patch, forget_rerere, delete_variable, create_variable, update_variable, or create_secret
correctness_properties.invariant: the method returns None and does not attempt to parse the response body

execution_paths.title: Happy path: submit rebuild and poll to completion

steps.action: instantiate HubClient(endpoint_url, pat) to obtain a client
create a shared httpx.AsyncClient with Authorization: Bearer <pat> header
call submit_rebuild(slug, strategy='merge', fail_mode='stop')
send POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuild with JSON body and receive HTTP 202 with RebuildJob JSON
parse response into RebuildJob and return it to the caller
call poll_rebuild(client, slug, rebuild_id, timeout=600.0, interval=5.0)
call client.get_rebuild(slug, rebuild_id) and receive a non-terminal RebuildJob
call asyncio.sleep(5.0) and repeat the poll
call client.get_rebuild(slug, rebuild_id) and receive a RebuildJob with status 'completed'
return the terminal RebuildJob to the caller

execution_paths.title: Happy path: resolve auth and create a workspace variable

steps.action: call resolve_hub_pat(token_flag=None) with AF_HUB_TOKEN set in the environment
read AF_HUB_TOKEN from the environment and return the PAT string
call resolve_hub_url(hub_url_flag=None, config_url='https://hub.example.com') with AF_HUB_URL not set
return config_url 'https://hub.example.com' as the resolved URL
instantiate HubClient(endpoint_url='https://hub.example.com', pat=<resolved PAT>)
call create_variable(slug, key='MY_KEY', value='my_value')
send POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/vars with JSON body {key, value} and receive HTTP 201
return None to the caller
call get_workspace(slug) on an existing HubClient
send GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug; httpx raises ConnectTimeout
call asyncio.sleep(1.0) for the first backoff interval
retry GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug; hub returns HTTP 200 with Workspace JSON
parse the response into a Workspace model and return it to the caller

execution_paths.title: set_variable upsert: PATCH 404 falls back to POST

steps.action: call set_variable(slug, key='NEW_KEY', value='val') on an existing HubClient
send PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/vars/NEW_KEY; hub returns HTTP 404
catch HubNotFoundError from the PATCH response
send POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/vars with JSON body {key: 'NEW_KEY', value: 'val'}; hub returns HTTP 201
return None to the caller

execution_paths.title: poll_clone_ready: clone fails and raises HubError

steps.action: call poll_clone_ready(client, slug, timeout=300.0, interval=5.0)
call client.get_workspace(slug) and receive a Workspace with clone_status='pending'
call asyncio.sleep(5.0) and repeat the poll
call client.get_workspace(slug) and receive a Workspace with clone_status='failed' and clone_error='disk full'
raise HubError(status_code=0, error_type='clone_failed', message='disk full') to the caller

execution_paths.title: add_patch and add_patches_batch use distinct request bodies

steps.action: call add_patch(slug, 'feature/my-branch', position=1) on an existing HubClient
send POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches with a single-object JSON body and receive HTTP 201 with Patch JSON
parse the response into a Patch model and return it to the caller
call add_patches_batch(slug, [{...}, {...}]) on the same HubClient
send POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches with a JSON array body and receive HTTP 201 with list[Patch] JSON
parse the response into list[Patch] and return it to the caller

error_handling.condition: Hub returns HTTP 401 on any request
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubAuthError(status_code=401, message=<envelope message>, error_type=<envelope error_type>)

error_handling.condition: Hub returns HTTP 403 on any request
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubForbiddenError(status_code=403, message=<envelope message>, error_type=<envelope error_type>)

error_handling.condition: Hub returns HTTP 404 on any request
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubNotFoundError(status_code=404, message=<envelope message>, error_type=<envelope error_type>)

error_handling.condition: Hub returns HTTP 409 on any request
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubConflictError(status_code=409, message=<envelope message>, error_type=<envelope error_type>); error_type is stored for caller inspection

error_handling.condition: Hub returns HTTP 400 with an unrecognized error_type
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubError(status_code=400, message=<envelope message>, error_type=<unrecognized value>)

error_handling.condition: ConnectTimeout, ReadTimeout, or ConnectError raised on all 3 retry attempts
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubConnectionError after the third retry; no further attempts are made

error_handling.condition: poll_rebuild timeout elapses before a terminal RebuildJob status is observed
poll_clone_ready observes clone_status='failed' on the Workspace
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubError(status_code=0, error_type='clone_failed', message=workspace.clone_error or 'Workspace clone failed')

error_handling.condition: poll_clone_ready timeout elapses before clone_status reaches 'ready' or 'failed'
Hub error response body is not valid JSON or does not match the error envelope schema
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubError with the raw HTTP status code and a best-effort message; do not propagate a JSON parse exception

error_handling.condition: Hub returns an unexpected 5xx status code
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubError(status_code=<5xx>, message=<parsed or raw message>)

error_handling.condition: HubConnectionError propagates from get_rebuild during poll_rebuild
error_handling.behavior: Abort the poll immediately and surface the HubConnectionError to the caller

error_handling.condition: HubConnectionError propagates from get_workspace during poll_clone_ready
error_handling.behavior: Abort the poll immediately and surface the HubConnectionError to the caller

error_handling.condition: rollback_rebuild response body is missing the 'previous_integration_head_sha' key
error_handling.behavior: Raise HubError(status_code=200, error_type='missing_field', message='Response missing expected key: previous_integration_head_sha'); do not return None silently

symbols.name: AsyncClient
symbols.signature: AsyncClient(*, base_url: str = '', headers: dict | None = None, timeout: float | None = None, **kwargs) -> AsyncClient
symbols.notes: Used as the shared HTTP session inside HubClient. Supports async context manager protocol. Must be closed via aclose() or used as 'async with'.

symbols.name: ConnectTimeout
symbols.notes: Raised when a TCP connection attempt exceeds the configured timeout. Triggers retry in HubClient._http.

symbols.name: ReadTimeout
symbols.notes: Raised when reading a response body exceeds the configured timeout. Triggers retry in HubClient._http.

symbols.name: ConnectError
symbols.notes: Raised when a TCP connection cannot be established. Triggers retry in HubClient._http.

symbols.name: BaseModel
symbols.notes: Base class for all afhub Pydantic models.

symbols.name: ConfigDict
symbols.notes: Used to set model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore') on all afhub models.

symbols.name: ValidationError
symbols.notes: Raised by Pydantic when required fields are missing or field types are invalid.

symbols.name: asyncio_mode
symbols.notes: When set to 'auto', all async test functions are automatically treated as asyncio coroutines without requiring @pytest.mark.asyncio decorators.
